purpose: Frequency-based corroboration of the compliance stiffness, computed from the committed run without modifying it

compliance.criterion: A real vibrational mode has reduced mass below the total molecular mass, and a transverse bend of a linear fragment should land near a third to a half of it. A stiffness implying more than the molecular mass is falsified by the frequency.

clamped.criterion: A real vibrational mode has reduced mass below the total molecular mass, and a transverse bend of a linear fragment should land near a third to a half of it. A stiffness implying more than the molecular mass is falsified by the frequency.

conclusion: The observed 88.3 cm^-1 soft mode implies a reduced mass of 15.8 amu for the compliance-based 7.27 N/m, which is 0.39 of the molecular mass and exactly what a transverse bend of a linear fragment should look like. The clamped diagonal block, 79.8 N/m, would require 173.6 amu, 4.3 times the entire molecule, which is impossible. The frequency does not merely favour the compliance route, it falsifies the clamped one.
